COLLECT CONSENT: a phone-auth app must show consent language at the point of number entry - e.g. 'I agree to receive one-time passcodes and account notification texts. Msg&data rates may apply. Reply STOP to unsubscribe, HELP for help.' The platform's carrier registration depends on hosted apps doing this.
STOP/HELP keywords are handled automatically at the carrier level; opted-out recipients are refused.
Transactional content ONLY from the shared number - no marketing/promotional SMS.
